canonical_project: firstcolo FRA7 Rosbach vor der Höhe
notes: firstcolo announced ground-breaking in Rosbach on 2026-06-15 with around EUR250m investment; SPIE says the FRA7 project is designed for 16 MW IT load and should be completed by the end of 2028. firstcolo marketing also describes 24 MW total capacity, so 16 MW IT load is recorded as the conservative capacity figure.
